"I broke too... when goan got away with his deception... I lashed out and him and broke my hand on a bulkhead.... being a good leader doesnt mean you you wont make mistakes... it means learning from them."  pauses a moment "you said you wish to protect.... you wish to prove me wrong.... you said my opinion of you matters... do you think giving up will amend that opinion?  It is your right to quit.... but you can't earn my trust be shirking your promises.... ultimately its up to you.... but I feel there is no one that can do the job like you." shakes his head "regardless... you are my friend.... but make amends with yourself and others before you quit on us"
there is not an ounce of malice or ill intent.... he is not attempting to manipulate you or stop you.  He says those words as if they are simple fact
"I was going to leave Roanoke. Abandon you all. How can you trust me to lead when I just wanted to flee."
"you haven't left yet have you?  Last night I almost joined my kind here, and left you all.  Do you mistrust me now?"
"had i left, that one would still be having terrors" points to Viola laying in a raft in the pond

"And if i am being honest..... I only resisted leaving because of how i feel towards someone here.... so if you cant be leader for thinking of leaving.... then Neither can I.  Would you say they don't need me?"
Cato nods in understanding. "How do I forgive myself?"

"start with the words.... I like 'I am flawed, but will learn from this, I deserve forgiveness.  I can be a better person' then ask forgiveness of those that you hurt.  Even if they hurt you, ask for theirs.  Apologize.  Even if they deny it.... you will feel better.  My enslaved school.... I prayed nightly to each one I failed to save for forgiveness.  I still pray to my friends" motioning to the statues "to forgive me.  I failed them too.  And, I asked Goan for his forgiveness.  Say the words to yourself, then everyone else.... each step will heal"
"I have faith in you to overcome this, you just need faith in yourself"
"I am flawed, but will learn from this, I deserve forgiveness. I can be a better person." Cato nods at the words. Thank you Gil. May I have some berries. Ten will do."
